claim.why_it_matters: Wrong heading level: the PDF prints 7.6 as a second-level section under chapter 7 (same style as 7.1 and 7.2, which the markdown renders '###'), but the markdown renders it '##', the level of the chapter heading '## 7. COMMUNICATION FACILITY', so it reads as a sibling of chapter 7.

verdict.reasoning: The rendered page 119 (300 dpi) prints the heading '7.6 THE CONCEPT OF TRANSACTION COMMUNICATION' and page-119.md carries it with identical text in the same position, so nothing is missing and the kind 'missing-heading' is wrong. The only difference is the markdown heading level, which is formatting. Its premise is also selective: in specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md the Communication chapter renders 7.1 and 7.2 as '###' but 7.3, 7.4 and 7.5 as '##' (lines 4947, 5075, 5083), so 7.6 is consistent with its nearest siblings; the inconsistency sits in 7.1/7.2 against 7.3-7.6 across the whole chapter, not on this page. The section number, title and body text match the PDF, so the meaning is unchanged.
